verdict.rationale: Stripe documents natural-language operation through agents. Link CLI shows example prompts such as "Buy me this book from Stripe Press" and "What did I spend on dining this month?", with purchases approved by the customer. The hosted MCP server, probed live, lets agents act on the Stripe API, and MPP can be built from a single prompt to a coding agent. Buyers can also browse and complete purchases inside a conversation. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language interface (all of this runs through the user's own agent or MCP client), general availability (the embedded checkout and agent-intermediary flows are private preview), and independent hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation working end to end.
